notes.2: Candidates needed to expand out the integrand before any progress could be made. Candidates who obtained and used an expanded-out integrand, many were able to integrate to obtain an acceptable form. When substituting the limits, many candidates appeared to use their calculator to obtain the final result, thus losing the exact value required in the final answer.
